description: Source code for inlining functions and methods within the Torch JIT compiler, including logic for inlining function and method calls in computational graphs.

methods.name: tryToGraphFunction
methods.description: Attempts to retrieve a GraphFunction object from a Node representing a function or method call.

methods.name: inlineCalls
methods.description: Recursively inlines function and method calls within a block of nodes.

methods.name: Inline
methods.description: Performs inlining on the entire graph, calling inlineCalls on its main block.
